Subject: DISCLOSURE UNDER REGULATION 30 OF SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA (LISTING 
OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015 (“LISTING REGULATIONS”) - SCHEDULE 
OF ANALYST/INVESTOR MEETING 
 
Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations read with Para A (15)(a) of Part A of 
Schedule III thereto, this is to inform you that a conference call for analysts/institutional investors will be held 
on Friday, August 14, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. (IST) in respect of the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and 
Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter ended June 31, 2026, as per the details attached herewith. 
 
Please note that no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) is proposed to be shared by the Company 
during the aforesaid investor meeting. 
 
The above disclosure is also being made available on the website of the Company at www.hexagonnutrition.com  
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you,  
For and on behalf of HEXAGON NUTRITION LIMITED 
 
 
________________________ 
Vedanti Vartak  
Company Secretary & Compliance officer
